Name: Automated Mining Drills
Author: drewdus42
Description:
[center]
[size=4]This Mod has been Rewritten so as not to need Producer Framework Mod or Json Assets.
It now only needs Content Patcher[/size][size=2].

Hoping this removes some issues for many players experiencing issues from Json Assets.

[/size][color=#ff7700][size=3][u]If you are updating to 2.0 from a 1.0 version:[/u][/size][/color][size=2][color=#ff7700]
Try to pick up and destroy the old drills before updating.
Otherwise you may have the old drills show up as errors.
Sometimes there is an issue trying to pick them up if there is an output in them.
You should be able to hit them with an upgraded hoe from over 1 tile away.
I think using bombs on them also works.

Worst case: reinstall the latest Old Version 1.4.0  to remove them.[/color]
[/size]

[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Please Report any bugs you find or edge cases that aren't behaving as expected[/b][/size][/color]
